description: v1 draft. From the review-log 2026-10-02 transcription of Professor Elias's inline sheet (the image itself is not in the repo, so NOTHING here is pixel-sampled): the six palette chips navy / dark brown / taupe / cream / gold / teal as named, plus the transcribed colours (grey hair + beard, blue cravat, cream robe, dark brown trousers, brown boots + belt + satchel, dark bracers, navy gold-trimmed mantle, brass armillary, teal orb + brooch gem, dark tome). Skin is a warm placeholder until the sheet can be sampled. Glow: the teal crystal only (staff orb + brooch gem), subtle.

skin.note: PLACEHOLDER warm fair skin (hue 26, sat 0.40): not sampled -- the sheet image is inline-only; never Blender grey

skin_shadow.note: authored jaw / neck cast shadow, one value step down at the skin hue

lips.note: a step paler + less saturated than skin (the house rule)

lash.note: upper lash band (dark grey-brown: an old man's lashes)

brow.note: HEAVY grey brows (sheet: heavy brows), a step darker than the hair so they read on skin

face_line.note: painted age lines (crow's feet, forehead): a soft step darker than skin

beard_inner.note: v4: the zone UNDER the beard shell, seen at most as a thin strip at the shell's sunk edge -- set between hair_beard_root and beard_fade1 (= hair_root -> skin 0.15, sRGB lerp) so that strip continues the fade instead of outlining it (v3: [108, 106, 103], the dark inner tone under the locks)

beard_fade1.note: v4 derived: grey stubble fade step 1 (next to the beard shell) = hair_root -> skin 0.35 (sRGB lerp)

beard_fade2.note: v4 derived: stubble fade step 2 = hair_root -> skin 0.60

beard_fade3.note: v4 derived: stubble fade step 3 (outermost, serrated) = hair_root -> skin 0.82

eye_iris.note: kind blue-grey (not in the transcription: an artist question)

hair_inner.note: v2: the DARK inner cap restored to Wren's ratio (inner / hair 0.54-0.56; v1 lightened it to hide the bald cap -- coverage fixes that now)

hair_crevice.note: tuck shade under the lock above (Wren ratio 0.62)

hair_beard.note: v4 beard / mustache SHELL body = the hair grey (sheet: full grey beard); own region = a separate beard-tone knob

hair_beard_root.note: v4 shell root tier (the top edge, into the fade) = hair_root

hair_beard_crevice.note: v4 lobe-join groove lines: a soft step under hair_beard (measured: the full hair_crevice tone 116 read as dark bars down the beard)

robe_roll.note: the big rolled sleeves, a touch lighter (fold highlight)

brass.note: gold / brass: buckle, brooch, crest, motifs, armillary, ferrule, clasp (chip: gold)

brass_dark.note: brass grooves, the brooch's raised crest

scroll_paper.note: parchment scrolls poking out of the satchel

crystal.note: TEAL: the staff orb + the brooch gem (chip: teal); the only glow, subtle

glasses.note: round wire glasses (gold wire; the frame colour is an artist question)

capelet.note: capelet: the mantle navy a hair lighter (layer separation)

material.note: the house shaded material: Col x baked AO, baked normal map; no cel bands, no outline shells
